speaker: john_heminges
text: The door is shut. Half a yard, and that is the afternoon done. Sit on the chests. I have a sheet, and I would like it heard once.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Hear the road first. In Kent they've not heard one word of it set down. I could be new every night.

speaker: george_bryan
text: We do not know that it is Kent. Kent is only the tiring-house guess. I was at Elsinore with you, ten years since. A marshal's man in every county, by the look of that paper.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Players on a road are vagrants till they have shown my lord's warrant to each constable in turn. I have done that showing. I do not want it in a hot July.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You are asking me to be old, in a city that has already heard me. The country has not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, oats and horse-hire, and both dearer every mile in a year like this. Item, country mayors, who dread a crowd worse than ours does.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, hired men at five shillings in the country and ten here. Item, the whole Bankside with nowhere to spend a penny of an afternoon but in this yard.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A wagon costs us every day it moves. An empty yard costs us only on the days we open it. I say play on till St James's tide, rest the house in August, and open at Bartholomew.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I want my house earning. A dark house is a locked rent. I did not build a yard so that a wagon could have it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I want three clear weeks to con a king. Give me the weeks. I am not asking for the wagon.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Will. A month with no play in it is a month you can write in. Say the rest. It suits you better than it suits the hired men.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It suits me better than it suits the hired men. I am not proud of the fit. I vote with John.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then say what you have carried, and let me be the man against it, in words a hired man can repeat.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Last day Saturday the twenty-sixth. Open again Monday the twenty-fifth of August. The question looked at again on the seventeenth. Nobody pretends the City's temper is settled.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Carried, Kemp against. I am not adding a wage to it. Ten here while we are open. Five is the country figure on that sheet, and the country is the thing we are not doing.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The house earns till the twenty-sixth. I have heard the date. I will live on the date.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Three weeks inside that rest. I will con the king in them. I am not asking the yard to see me do it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And no constable between here and a town we cannot name. I will take a known yard over a warrant in my hand.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Augustine has sat the chest and kept his mouth. The singing is tonight, not this vote.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I am against, and I am still coming to the ordinary, and I am not pretending the against was a joke.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Against is written. The sheet stands. The jug can have the corner of the chest. I am done with the miles.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Done. We play on. The road stays a guess.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Write the twenty-sixth, the twenty-fifth of August, and the seventeenth. I want them at the foot, where a man can find them after the ale.

speaker: john_heminges
text: They are at the foot. I do not write a sum under them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No sum. The month is for the pages, and the pages are not a wage.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You have said it aloud. That was the part I wanted heard. I am still against the rest.
